notes: Fake security team sends a credential-reset link and then asks for the MFA code. Rule 1 (link to a page capturing credentials) -> T1598.003. The ticket number is an 'other' IOC. Fear (suspension) and urgency (20 minutes) are explicit.

messages.content: Hello Amy, this is Acme Security Operations. Your mailbox was used to send spam overnight (ticket SEC-20417). We need to secure it immediately.
omg what?? I didn't send anything. what do I need to do?
Reset your password at https://acme-m365-security.example/reset using your current credentials so we can verify ownership.
ok it's loading. sorry, which team did you say you're on? I don't think we covered this in onboarding
Security Operations. You'll receive a 6-digit code on your phone. Send it to me here so I can finish the reset on our side.
I thought we're not supposed to share codes? can I call the helpdesk to check?
There's no time for that. If the reset isn't completed in 20 minutes your account will be suspended and you'll lose access to email and payroll.
